get.summary:
Training programs and certificates related to a single competency level, matching the
MVC level-expand AJAX call (`Ims.Portal.Web.Areas.Competencies.Controllers.HomeController.JadaratDetails`,
route `FinancialSkills/FinancialSkillDetails/{competencyId}/{levelId}`), which
returns pre-rendered HTML partials - this endpoint calls the exact same
M:Ims.Portal.Bll.Interfaces.Training.IProgramService.GetAllProgramsAsync(Ims.Training.Model.ViewModels.Search.IndexUserFiltersViewModel) / M:Ims.Portal.Bll.Interfaces.Exams.IExamService.GetAllExams(Ims.Exams.Model.ViewModels.Search.IndexUserFilterViewModel)
services and returns the same underlying data as structured JSON instead.
The MVC page/JS identifies a level by `Level.Id` (the shared master level primary
key used as `Program.CompetencyLevelId` / `Exam.CompetencyLevelId`), which is
not exposed by M:Ims.Portal.Api.Areas.Competencies.Controllers.FinancialSkillsController.GetCompetencyDetails(System.Guid). To avoid changing that endpoint's
contract, this endpoint accepts the competency id + the level's visible number (1-5) and
resolves the matching `Level.Id` itself, via the same
`CompetenciesRepository.GetCompetenciesDetailsById` call M:Ims.Portal.Api.Areas.Competencies.Controllers.FinancialSkillsController.GetCompetencyDetails(System.Guid)
and the MVC page both use.
get.description:
The level is matched against `Level.Code`, not `Level.Order`: `Level.Order`
is only used elsewhere (`CompetencyLevelsRepository`/`LevelsRepository`) to sort
levels for display and is not guaranteed to hold the visible level number (in production
data all 5 levels of at least one competency have `Order == 0`). `Level.Code` is
the field the rest of the app uses to represent the level's visible number/identity - see
`LevelsRepository.GetLevelCode`/`GetLevelCodeAsync`,
`CompetenciesDtoRepository.GetCompetencyLevelById`/`GetCompetenciesDtoById`, and
`JobFamilyDetailsResponseDto.JobRoleSkillDto.Level` (documented there as "Level.Code -
NOT Level.Order"). It is a `string`, not an `int`, so the incoming
levelOrder is compared as a string.

Business rules are unchanged from MVC: programs are matched by level only
(`Program.CompetencyLevelId == Level.Id`, competency not filtered - see
`ProgramsRepository.ApplyProgramFilters`); certificates are matched by level and
competency (`Exam.CompetencyLevelId == Level.Id` and joined to the competency via
`ExamCompetecies` - see `ExamsRepository.GetAllExamsPaging`). Paging mirrors the
MVC page: when pageNumber/pageSize are omitted, the
same per-section defaults MVC relies on apply (10 for programs, 12 for certificates).

parameters.description: Competency id.

parameters.name: levelOrder
parameters.description:
The level's visible number (e.g. 1-5), matched against `Level.Code` - kept as the
parameter name for backward compatibility even though it no longer maps to
`Level.Order` (see remarks).

requestId.description:
Identifier of the entity being favorited. Recommended value going forward:
the canonical parent id — Program.Id for Training, Exam.Id for Exam, Event.Id
for Event. Legacy clients may still send Plan.Id for Training; the server
resolves either value to the same favorite row keyed by Program.Id internally.

paymentModuleId.description: Payment module discriminator (1 = Event, 2 = Exam, 3 = Training).

title.description: Localized section title (the web falls back to a default label when empty).

description.description: Localized section description shown under the title.

steps.description: Ordered application steps configured on the program, sorted by step order.

ApplicationProcessDto.description: Application process / admission steps section (آلية التقديم) of the program details page.

ApplicationProcessStepDto.description: A single ordered step in the program's application process.

name.description: Localized sector name (e.g. البنوك، الأوراق المالية، التأمين، التمويل).

numberOfExams.description: Number of published exams tagged with this sector.

icon.description: Sector icon (markup / class / url as stored on the sector).

url.description: Absolute link to the certificates listing filtered by this sector.

CertificateCategoryDto.description: A main category (exam sector) card. Sourced from the existing exam-sector top-menu data.

CertificateCategoryDtoOverviewSectionDto.description:
Generic overview section wrapper carrying the localized heading text plus its items,
so the frontend can render the title/subtitle without hard-coding copy.

icon.description: Optional logo/icon url for the policy provider.

CertificatePolicyDto.description: A policy card in the "Professional Exams Policy" section.

CertificatePolicyDtoOverviewSectionDto.description:
Generic overview section wrapper carrying the localized heading text plus its items,
so the frontend can render the title/subtitle without hard-coding copy.

CertificatesOverviewDto.description:
Aggregated payload for the public Certificates (Exams) Overview page
(https://fa.gov.sa/Services/Exams/overview). Returns every section the page needs
in a single response so the frontend does not have to issue multiple calls.

CreateOrUpdatePracticalExperienceDto.description: DTO used for creating or updating Practical Experience records.

id.description:
Gets or sets the training course identifier.
If null or empty, a new training course will be created.
Otherwise, the existing training course will be updated.

courseLevelId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the training course level.

courseName.description: Gets or sets the name of the training course.

field.description: Gets or sets the training field or specialization.

dateFrom.description: Gets or sets the start date of the training course.

dateTo.description: Gets or sets the end date of the training course.

isInSideFA.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the training
was provided internally within the organization.

numberOfDays.description: Gets or sets the total number of training days.

organizationName.description: Gets or sets the name of the organization that provided the training.

programId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the related training program.

sectorId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the training sector.

trainingCourseAttachmentId.description:
Gets or sets the identifier of the stored attachment
if the training course already has an uploaded file.

CreateTrainingCourseApiDto.description:
Data transfer object used to create or update a training course qualification
for the currently authenticated user.

description.description:
Marketing summary of the event (HTML), rendered on the web featured-event card
via `@Html.Raw(eventItem.Description)`. Source: `Event.SummaryAr`/`Event.SummaryEn`
depending on the current culture.

speakerName.description: Name of the first speaker of the event (empty when the event has no speakers).

detailsPageURL.description: Public details page URL of the event.

isFuture.description:
True when the event has not started yet. The web featured card only shows the
"Book Now" button for future events (`display-if="eventItem.IsFuture"`).

userRate.description: Gets or sets the user Rate required.

speakerAvatar.description: Gets or sets the avatar URL of the event's main speaker (Event cards only).

eventTime.description:
Gets the event time range formatted as "HH:mm - HH:mm" (e.g. "17:30 - 19:00").
Null when the schedule times are not available.

eventEnded.description: True when the event's last day has passed (same rule as Event Details).

isRegistrationClosed.description: True when the registration end date has passed (same rule as Event Details).

registrationStatusMessage.description: Localized registration status: event ended, registration finished, fully booked, or empty.

isRegistered.description: Whether the signed-in user holds a confirmed registration for the event; null for anonymous requests.

EventsOverviewDto.description:
Aggregated response for the Events Overview page
(`GET /api/v1/Home/EventsOverview`).
Mirrors the sections rendered by the MVC Events Overview page
(`~/Services/Events/Overview`) while reusing existing DTOs
(Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Events.EventCardDto) and existing business logic.

title.description: Localized section title (empty when the page sources it from CMS).

description.description: Localized section description (empty when the page sources it from CMS).

viewAllUrl.description: Absolute URL for the "View All" navigation link.

bookNowText.description:
Localized "Book Now" call-to-action text. Only populated for the featured events
section, where the web page renders the button for events with
Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Events.EventCardDto.IsFuture = true.

items.description: The event cards for this section.

EventsOverviewSectionDto.description: A titled section of event cards plus its "View All" navigation link.

profileId.description: The selected exam profile (file) the user wants to register for.

testCenterScheduleDayPeriodId.description: The selected test-center schedule day period.

requirements.description:
Registration requirements supplied by the user. For file requirements (e.g. CV)
Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Exams.ExamRegistrationRequirementApiDto.Data must be a base64 string and
Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Exams.ExamRegistrationRequirementApiDto.FileName must include the file extension.

ExamAddToCartApiDto.description:
Payload sent to the Exam AddToCart endpoint.
Carries the selected profile and schedule plus any registration requirements
(e.g. a CV file) the exam needs before the reservation can be created.

ExamCardDtoOverviewSectionDto.description:
Generic overview section wrapper carrying the localized heading text plus its items,
so the frontend can render the title/subtitle without hard-coding copy.

id.description:
Id of the ExamRegistrationRequirement row (the binding between the exam and the requirement definition).
Returned by GetExamDetailsById in RegistrationRequirments[].Id.

requiremntId.description:
Id of the underlying RegistrationRequirement definition.
Returned by GetExamDetailsById in RegistrationRequirments[].RegistrationRequirementId.

data.description:
The submitted value. For text/number requirements this is the raw value;
for File requirements this must be a base64-encoded file content.

isRequired.description: Whether the requirement is mandatory (mirrors the value returned by GetExamDetailsById).

fileName.description: Required only when Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Exams.ExamRegistrationRequirementApiDto.DataTypeId is File. Must include the file extension (e.g. "cv.pdf").

ExamRegistrationRequirementApiDto.description: A single registration requirement input submitted alongside an exam reservation.

photo.description: Absolute URL of the speaker photo.

ExpertSpeakerDto.description:
Minimal expert-speaker card. Populated from the same production logic used by
`GET /api/v1/Home/Experts`
(`IProgramService.GetThisMonthAllTrainers` -> `SpeakerViewModel`).

items.description: The expert speaker cards for this section.

ExpertSpeakersSectionDto.description: The expert speakers section (localized title/description + speaker cards).

ExploreCertificatesDto.description:
Call-to-action for the "Explore Certificates" section. The actual listing is served by the
existing exam search endpoint (POST Exam/Search); this only carries the section title and link.

title.description:
Training Type IDs:
1	تدريب حضوري	In Class Training
2	تدريب عن بعد Online Training
3	تعلم ذاتي   Self Learning

programParticipantLevelIds.description:
Optional. Program participant-level ids (target audience level) to filter by.
Matches the "Participant Level" filter on the Programs discovery page.
Values come from `GET api/v1/Program/GetProgramParticipantLevels`.
Omit or send null to apply no participant-level filtering (backward compatible).

dateFrom.description:
Optional. Lower bound (inclusive) for a plan's start date. Maps to the internal
`startDate` filter used by the Programs discovery page's date range.

dateTo.description:
Optional. Upper bound (inclusive) for a plan's end date. Maps to the internal
`endDate` filter used by the Programs discovery page's date range.

programs.description: Training Programs (برامج تدريبية) — programs in the Training package.

selfLearningPrograms.description: Self Learning Programs (برامج التعلم الذاتي) — programs with a Self-Learning training type.

knowledgeSeminars.description: Knowledge Seminars (ندوات معرفية) — events in the Knowledge Seminars package.

sectorExpertsMeetings.description: Sector Experts Meetings (لقاءات خبراء القطاع) — events in the Sector Experts package.

FinancialSectorGatewayDto.description:
DTO that holds the four Financial Sector Gateway categories, mirroring the MVC
`HomeController.GetFinancialSectorGatewayPrograms` behavior.

iconSvg.description:
Kept for backward compatibility. Sourced from `Sector.Icon`, which is never
populated by any write path in the system - always null today. Uploaded sector icons
are available via Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.FinancialSkills.FrameworkStructureSectorDto.IconUrl instead.

iconUrl.description:
Absolute URL of the sector's uploaded icon attachment, if one was uploaded
(`Sector.IconAttachment`). Null when no icon was uploaded for this sector.

fullName.description: Display name (first and last name), as shown on the website.

linkedInUrl.description: LinkedIn profile url, if the trainer provided one.

xUrl.description: X (Twitter) profile url, if the trainer provided one.

HomeExpertDto.description:
An expert card for the Home page "Experts Platform" (منصة الخبراء) section.
Sourced from the existing this-month trainers list (`IProgramService.GetThisMonthAllTrainers`),
so only the fields the system actually stores for that source are exposed.

isDefault.description:
True for the role the MVC page shows active/expanded by default (the first role
returned by `GetJobRoleByFamiliesIdsPaging` - order preserved as-is).

level.description:
Raw level value as returned by `CompetenciesRepository.GetCompetencyByJobRoleIdPaging`
(`Level.Code` for this job role's competency mapping - NOT `Level.Order`).
Kept as-is (string) since its exact format ("1".."5" vs something else) is DB content
that could not be verified from code; do not assume it parses cleanly to int.

typeId.description:
Raw competency type, included alongside the Technical/Behavioral bucketing so the
caller can independently verify/regroup - see remarks in FinancialSkillsJobFamilyService.

isLoggedIn.description: Whether the request carries an authenticated user; completion statuses are only meaningful when true.

LearningInitiativeDto.description:
FAST-owned data of the Financial Awareness Platform page (/LearningInitiative).
CMS-driven sections are consumed by the client directly from the CMS and are not part of this DTO.

requiredTimeInMinutes.description: Required time rounded up to minutes; 0 when the unit has no required time.

data.description: Current Identity keys: identityNumber, transId, and randomNumber.

billNumber.description: Bill number (also the SADAD bill number the organization pays with).

isCreatedInSadad.description: Whether the bill was successfully created in SADAD.

paymentRefId.description: Payment reference, set once the payment is confirmed.

PayLaterBillDto.description: Organization pay-later bill and its current persisted payment state.

isTaxInvoice.description: Issue a tax invoice (seat vouchers only).

PayLaterRequestDto.description: Organization pay-later (SADAD bill) request. Same fields the MVC Web sends to `Payment/ConfirmPayLater`.

name.description: Localized sector name (e.g. البنوك، التمويل، التأمين، الأوراق المالية).

numberOfPrograms.description: Number of programs tagged with this sector.

icon.description: Sector icon (markup / class / url as stored on the sector).

url.description: Absolute link to the programs listing filtered by this sector.

ProgramCategoryDto.description: A main category (program sector) card. Sourced from the existing program-sector statistics.

userFavoritId.description: Gets or sets the user favorite Id for the program.

programTopics.description: Program topics (المواضيع) listed on the program details page.

detailsPageURL.description: Shareable absolute URL to the program details page on the frontend portal.

location.description:
Location of the program's nearest plan, formatted as the details page shows it:
the plan city, "Online training" for online plans, or "Self learning" for self-learning plans.
Null when the program has no plans.

locations.description: Distinct locations across all of the program's plans, in plan start-date order.

numberOfLessons.description: Number of lessons in the program agenda, taken from the same plan value the details page renders.

relatedPrograms.description: Related programs (برامج ذات صلة) shown on the details page.

suggestedCertificates.description: Suggested certificates (الشهادات المقترحة) shown on the details page.

durationInDays.description:
Program duration in days. Sourced from `Program.NumberOfDays` (same value used as
`DurationInDays` in the programs listing). Shown on the Purchase Program screen.

totalLearningHours.description:
Total learning hours for the program. Sourced from `Program.NumberOfHours`
(same value used as `DurationInHours` in the programs listing).

numberOfRegisteredUsers.description:
Number of confirmed registered users across all plans of the program.
Populated in the controller from PlanTakers (Confirmed reservations only).

trainerCards.description:
Program trainer cards including social links (LinkedIn / X), sourced from the same
user-scoped trainer list the web details page renders (`SpeakerViewModel` via
`GetTrainersForPortalByProgramIdSimpleAsync`); the social links pass through those
existing fields. Added alongside the legacy Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDetailsDto.Trainers lookup list so existing
consumers are unaffected.

examId.description:
Raw exam reference (maps from `ProgramApiModel.ExamId`).
Used to compute Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDetailsDto.IsBundle / Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDetailsDto.BundleText.

isBundle.description:
True when the program is a bundle, mirroring the MVC card rule
(`_SelfProgramCardPartial.cshtml`): `!ExamId.IsNullOrDefault<Guid>()`.

bundleText.description: Localized bundle tag text, same resource used by the MVC card (`SharedResources.Bundle`).

endsWithExam.description: FAST-497: true when the program is linked to an exam ("ينتهي باختبار").

lastActionDate.description:
FAST-497: linked-exam block (name, question count, attempts, registration
window, trials pricing). Null when the program has no linked exam.

completedUnits.description:
Number of root agenda units (modules/lectures) completed by the current authenticated user
(الوحدات المكتملة). Sourced from the same LRS/xAPI status used by the program card.

totalUnits.description: Total number of root agenda units in the program, paired with Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDetailsDto.CompletedUnits.

completionPercentage.description:
Learning progress percentage (نسبة التقدم) for the current authenticated user, rounded.
Same value and calculation as the program card (`GetProgramCardInfo`).

ratingUsersCount.description:
Number of users who rated the program (reuses the RatingHelper-computed
`GetAllProgramsDto.NumberOfUserRates`).

isForStudent.description:
Raw audience source field (maps from `GetAllProgramsDto.IsForStudent`).
Used to compute Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDto.IsForIndividuals / Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDto.AudienceType.

isForIndividuals.description:
True when the program targets individuals ("للأفراد"), false when it targets students ("للطلاب").
Mirrors the generic program card rule in `_ProgramSummaryPartial.cshtml`.

audienceType.description:
Localized audience tag text exactly as shown on the program card
(`_ProgramSummaryPartial.cshtml`): "للمنشأة" when published for organizations,
otherwise "للطلاب" when Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.ProgramDto.IsForStudent is true, else "للأفراد".

isFavorite.description:
Convenience flag mirroring the card's favorite state
(`UserFavoritId == Guid.Empty` means not favorited).

isFree.description: Indicates whether the program is free.

freeMessage.description: Message shown when the program is free.

examName.description: Exam name (rendered as a link by the frontend).

examDetailsUrl.description: Relative details URL for the exam-name link.

numberOfFreeAttempts.description: عدد المحاولات المتاحة — free attempts granted after program completion.

registrationDurationDays.description: المدة المتاحة للتسجيل — days available to register/take the free exam after program completion.

trials.description: Trials table: trial number and price ("free" or fees).

ProgramExamDetailsDto.description:
FAST-497: linked-exam block shown on the Program Details page
for programs that end with an exam.

formattedPrice.description: "مجاني" for free trials, otherwise the formatted fee.

appliesToSubsequentTrials.description: True for the last row, meaning "this price applies to any further attempt".

ProgramExamTrialDto.description: FAST-497: one row of the trials/pricing table.

ProgramExpertDto.description: An expert/trainer card for the "Experts Platform" section (this month's freelance trainers).

ProgramsOfTheMonthDto.description:
The three "Programs of the Month" tabs. Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.Overview.ProgramsOfTheMonthDto.All is the union of
Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.Overview.ProgramsOfTheMonthDto.Individuals and Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Programs.Overview.ProgramsOfTheMonthDto.Organizations, matching the MVC page.

mainCategories.description: تصفح أهم الفئات — program sectors with the number of programs in each.

featuredPrograms.description: Featured/hero programs shown in the top slider (trending, curated).

selfLearningPrograms.description: برامج التعلم الذاتي — self-learning program cards.

ProgramsOverviewDto.description:
Aggregated domain data for the public Programs Overview page
(https://fa.gov.sa/Services/Programsoverview), returned in a single response so Web/Mobile
clients can render the page with one call.

CMS-authored presentation content (section titles/subtitles, button links and the
"Featured Topics" cards) is intentionally NOT included here — it stays owned by the headless
CMS and is fetched by the client directly, so this API takes no CMS/GraphQL/OAuth dependency.

id.description: The unique identifier of the requirement instance.

requiremntId.description: The ID of the required field definition.

data.description:
The input value for the requirement.
For file uploads, this should be a base64 string.

fileName.description: Required only if DataTypeId is File. Should be the file name with extension (e.g., resume.pdf).

RegistrationRequirementApiDto.description: Represents a requirement item for registration submission.

planId.description: The ID of the plan the user is registering for.

programId.description: The ID of the program the user is registering for.

requirements.description: A list of user-provided requirement inputs.

RegistrationSubmitApiDto.description: API-level model to handle registration submission input.

detailsPageURL.description: Shareable absolute URL to the report/study details page on the frontend portal.

newPlanId.description: Gets or sets the ID of the new training plan to which the reservation should be moved.

reservationId.description: Gets or sets the ID of the existing reservation that is to be rescheduled.

RescheduleDto.description: Represents the input data required to reschedule a reservation.

isFree.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the new plan is free after rescheduling.

RescheduleResponseDto.description: Represents the result of a reschedule operation.

eligibilityExamDetailsUrl.description:
Individual trainee: relative URL of the end exam's details page (/Services/ExamDetails/{examId}),
present only when he is eligible to register for it - program completed, attendance met
(self-learning exempt) and no active reservation on the exam yet. Null otherwise.

examRegisterLinkText.description: Label of the register link («تسجيل») shown next to Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.DashBoard.ReservationInfoResponseDto.EligibilityExamDetailsUrl; null when there is no link.

examEligibilityStatus.description:
Exam eligibility display label for a program that ends with an exam: «مؤهل للاختبار» when the
trainee may register (or already holds a reservation), «غير مؤهل بعد» otherwise. Empty when
the program has no end exam.

educationalMaterials.description:
Downloadable educational materials: for an exam reservation the profile material + the exam
study material; for a program that ends with an exam, the materials of the linked exam.

searchText.description: The search text that was executed (trimmed, as received).

programsCount.description: Total matching programs (not just the count returned in Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Search.SearchResultsDto.Programs).

examsCount.description: Total matching exams (not just the count returned in Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Search.SearchResultsDto.Exams).

eventsCount.description: Total matching events (not just the count returned in Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Search.SearchResultsDto.Events).

SearchResultsDto.description:
Structured equivalent of the public Search page (`Ims.Portal.Web HomeController.Search`,
route `~/Search`). Combines Programs, Exams, and Events matching Ims.Portal.Api.Dto.Search.SearchResultsDto.SearchText
so the frontend can render the same All/Programs/Exams/Events tabs from a single request,
mirroring how the MVC page fetches all three once and tabs them client-side (no per-tab re-query).

TopMenuDto.description:
API contract mirroring the MVC `TopMenu` structure returned by
`TopMenuService.GetTopMenuTree()`. Exposes the complete website top-menu tree
(programs, financial sector, exams, events, reports and initiatives) so that React
and other clients consume the exact same business data as the MVC application.

TrainingTopicsPageDto.description: Complete payload for the public Training Topics page.

TrendingHomeDto.description: DTO that holds trending data for home view.
